prompt:
Use case: production-game-assets. Modify only the skin clothing on the reference game's existing cream sheep, keeping its character identity and fifteen different poses. Image 1 is sheep identity and pose-layout reference; image 2 is the same game's sailor costume reference for exact coarse pixel outline, compact outfit scale and palette, not its sailor design. The observed existing pasture game is warm hand-pixelated flat 2D.
Character: round fluffy cream oval wool body, little peach square muzzle on the right, tiny dark eye, cocoa ear, FOUR short cocoa hooves; friendly sheep with no horns, arms, teeth or human hands. Face always clearly exposed. Same proportions and consistent outfit in every pose. Accessories stay compact and fully inside the cell. Do not turn sheep into another creature.
Output: one TRUE TRANSPARENT sprite sheet, exactly FIFTEEN complete full-body sprites in an even FIVE columns by THREE rows, landscape 5:3. Uniform scale, same body size, all sprites face RIGHT, generous clean transparent gaps between every sprite and rows, with outer margins. All art within its own cell; no clipping or adjacent overlap. No ground, backdrop, shadow, blur, glow, vignette, UI, text, labels, numbers, separators, grid lines or checkerboard. Hard square pixel edges, limited warm palette.
Exact row-major pose order:
Top row: idle standing; run1 front leg forward/back leg behind extended stride; run2 opposite diagonal stride; run3 legs gather underneath compressed step; run4 next opposite long stride.
Middle row: jump with hooves tucked airborne; fall with front feet reaching downward; hit recoiling and squeezed eye with face still right; dash1 leaning forward trailing legs; dead lying sideways eyes closed.
Bottom row: idle2 gentle blink and breath; run5 push-off with front leg raised and back leg pushing; run6 passing phase with other foreleg raised; dash2 other extended forward stride; dead_settled relaxed low-head lying pose.
All SIX run poses MUST have visibly different leg/hoof silhouettes, not cloned standing art. All FIFTEEN poses unique, same outfit retained through jump, hit and lying down. This must be an animation sprite sheet, not six duplicate portraits. 
Skin theme: Cream fluffy sheep in a tiny honey-yellow and cocoa striped bee vest, two short dark antennae on a compact honey-yellow hood, small soft pale-blue folded costume wing pair attached to its back. This is a sheep wearing a bee costume, four hooves exposed and sheep face completely visible. No flying, no extra legs, no floating bees. Same antennae and wings in every frame.
